website.note: Homepage describes SNAP-CAR and stem-cell expansion platforms in narrative form; no dedicated public pipeline table found at /pipeline (404). Investor materials confirm all assets remain preclinical or completed Phase 1.

excluded_preclinical.modality: Switchable adaptor-based CAR T / CAR NK cell therapy
excluded_preclinical.status: Preclinical; SNAP Biosciences subsidiary licensed Monarch Therapeutics small-molecule adaptor platform (May 2025) and continues IND-enabling work via Karolinska Institutet (KI) grant. No active IND or open clinical trial as of FY2025 10-K.

excluded_preclinical.modality: Gene-edited NK / immune effector cell therapy
excluded_preclinical.status: Preclinical. Worldwide exclusive rights acquired from Vy-Gen-Bio in March 2025; Coeptis stated intent to advance GEAR-modified NK cells into first-in-human studies but no IND or NCT trial open as of FY2025 10-K.
Program paused per FY2025 disclosures; no active clinical trial.

aka: unmodified pooled-donor CD34+ NK cell therapy
excluded_legacy_terminated.note: Both Phase 1 trials acquired with Deverra IND/asset purchase (Aug 2023). Trials are completed; no ongoing or follow-on company-sponsored clinical study disclosed in FY2025 10-K. Excluded per active P1/P2/P3 scope.

no_active_clinical_pipeline_reason: Although Coeptis is a development-stage cell-therapy company with platforms (SNAP-CAR, GEAR) and inherited DVX201 IND assets, no proprietary asset is currently in an active recruiting/ongoing Phase 1, 2, or 3 clinical trial as of the FY2025 10-K. The two acquired DVX201 NK-cell Phase 1 trials (NCT04900454, NCT04901416) are both COMPLETED. SNAP-CAR and GEAR platforms remain preclinical. The company also disclosed going-concern doubt and a planned Z Squared merger / biotech spin-out.
